page.layout: One text column with marginal notes in the left margin. Column runs from top to bottom; catchword "ram" at the lower right.

main_text.p: qui interficiunt, defendam, non in-venio. Quae etiam videtur fuisse sententia Poetae cujusdam Graeci, qui in Poemate è Graeco in Latinum verso, ita cecinit:

p.i: Ensem accingere non ad caedem, sed profectionem.
Utinam vero non egeas ense, neque juste, neque injuste.
Si namque interfeceris etiam hostem, tuam manum polluis.

main_text.p: Covarr. in c. si furiosus de Homicid.Cum quo facit Accursius Jurisconsultus, qui defensionem cum offensione jure fori, non coeli, licitam esse existumat, in ea tamen sententia à Berlich. Conclus. 12. parr. 4.Paulo Castrensi, Covarruviâ, aliisque reprehensus. Et consentiunt Anabaptistae, qui legem illam naturae, de vi illatâ repellendâ, praecepto Christi adversari tradunt. Et quidem objiciunt. 1. Illud Salvatoris: Matth. c. 5. v. 38. & seq.ego vero dico vobis, ne resistatis malo: sed quisquis te cadet in dexte-ram

page.notes: Faint printer's marks and a digitiser's imprint at the lower right were left out. "Thocyl." in the first marginal note is hard to read and is marked [?]. The catchword "ram" is printed at the foot, so the text continues on the next page. The word "cadet" is copied as printed. The word "enfe" is printed with a mark after it that was read as a comma.
